name: codex-surface-atlas
description: Use Rosalind Workbench plugins in Codex to find disease-associated cell-surface targets, inspect binding sites, and run selected screening or binder workflows.

interface.longDescription: Build a surface-target census, compare disease and normal-tissue evidence, inspect interventions and accessible sites, and review selected screening or binder results in linked target pages.
defaultPrompt: Use Rosalind Workbench database and literature plugins to find cell-surface targets for this disease and compare disease and normal-tissue evidence.
Register my molecule library, retrieve known ligand evidence with Rosalind Workbench plugins, and select a structure and site for screening.
Review this atlas workspace and produce an offline report with target pages, structures, results, and source citations.
